messages:
Priya S: Quick check — Week2 smoke for Nimbus private deploy: audit logs are only showing partial S3 prefixes, KMS alias 'nimbus-prod' not visible in the customer's account, and cutover approval meeting got pushed to Fri. Customer said they may delay renewal if we don't hit BETA next week. Can someone triage networking/IAM/KMS? What else should we run?

Ethan L: I'm on it. First things: can you paste the KMS ListAliases output and the S3 ACLs you see? Also confirm whether the delivery role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodLogDelivery exists.

Priya S: Copying outputs (sanitized):
```
aws kms list-aliases --key-id 1234abcd --profile customer
# shows aliases: alias/redwood-internal, alias/nimbus-staging  (no alias/nimbus-prod)
```
and
```
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-nimbus-audit-logs --profile customer
# owner: customer-account-id, grants include LogDelivery but only for prefix /staging
```
No delivery role found in the customer's account, only in ours.

Miguel R: Two quick checks: 1) KMS alias could be in a different region or under a different principal; ask them to run `aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2`. 2) For S3 delivery, confirm the bucket policy allows `s3:PutObject` from the customer's CloudTrail service principal. Often our docs miss the cross-account role step.

infra-bot: Runbook created: runbook/privdeploy/nimbus-week2 -> tasks: [verify-kms-alias, ensure-delivery-role, confirm-bucket-policy, smoke-s3-list, validate-audit-events]. Assigned: Ethan L, deadline: 1782510600.

Devon C: If they don't have a delivery role, we can propose a short snippet they can run to create it (one-liner IAM trust + attach policy). I can draft and drop into the ticket. Also recommend a temporary fallback: enable S3 prefix for staging -> route events there and verify end-to-end before prod alias is created.

Ethan L: For troubleshooting, I'll ask them to run this minimal check from their side and paste results: 
```
aws iam get-role --role-name RedwoodLogDelivery || echo 'no role'
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-nimbus-audit-logs --recursive | head -n 20
```
If they share outputs we can narrow to IAM vs KMS vs bucket policy.

Priya S: Thanks — I've pinged the customer with the commands and told them to drop outputs here. Also flagged renewal owner in Salesforce. They're nervous about timeline so I'm asking if we can offer a short-term SLA credit if we unblock by Thu.

Miguel R: Good idea on the credit — ops+sales should coordinate but let's avoid promising without legal. I'll schedule a quick 15m sync with Sales and CS for 11:30 PT. @Devon C can you prepare the IAM snippet and a one-paragraph runbook note we can send to the customer? :thumbsup:

Devon C: On it. Draft ready in ~30m, will post in the thread for review.

Priya S: Appreciate it. If we can get audit events flowing to S3 (even into staging prefix) and confirm KMS alias visibility, we can mark Week2 smoke as green and de-escalate renewal risk. :pray:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with customer at 1782511200 (30m).
